name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael Souza's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in São Paulo, where he spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts alongside his father, a mechanic. This early exposure instilled in him a deep understanding of mechanical systems and a relentless desire to optimize performance. After completing his technical degree, Rafael joined a local racing team, honing his skills in engine building and chassis tuning. His meticulous approach and problem-solving abilities quickly earned him recognition, leading to opportunities with larger racing organizations.

Rafael believes that precision and attention to detail are paramount in motorsport. He is known for his ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues quickly and devise innovative solutions to improve vehicle reliability and speed. He is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of engineering and contribute to the success of his team. He is seeking to expand his knowledge of advanced materials and manufacturing techniques to provide Team WRT with a competitive edge.

Rafael stands out for his unwavering commitment to excellence and his ability to thrive under pressure. He is always eager to learn and adapt, making him a valuable asset to any racing team. His colleagues appreciate his collaborative spirit and his willingness to share his expertise, making him an effective team player both in and out of the garage.
